name: Lau Ming Wa
source: Brother of Lau Ka Tung. A viceroy belonging to the Mong Kok Police Department. He contracts with Chang Lei to hire Senior Dumb and Junior Dumb brothers from "the Web".
translation: Brother of Lau Ka Tung. A viceroy belonging to the Mong Kok Police Department. He contracts with Chang Lei to hire Senior Dumb and Junior Dumb brothers from "the Web".
